name: When should I consider widening doorways in my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider widening doorways in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider widening doorways if you or a family member currently uses a wheelchair or other mobility device, anticipates needing one in the future, or if you plan to age in place. It's also a valuable upgrade for enhancing general home accessibility and can be beneficial for resale value, as accessible homes appeal to a broader market. Proactive planning helps avoid urgent modifications during a time of need.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider widening doorways if you use a mobility device, plan to age in place, or want to increase your home's general accessibility and potential resale value.
